### Checklist

- [x] I searched related issues but found no solution.
- [x] The bug persists in the latest version.
- [x] Issues without environment info and a minimal reproducible demo are hard to resolve and may receive no feedback.
- [x] If this is not a bug report but a general question, please start a discussion at https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/discussions. Otherwise, it will be closed.
- [x] Please use English. Otherwise, it will be closed.

### Describe the bug

Inkling-NVFP4 with built-in 8-layer multi-layer EAGLE OOMs during automatic KV-pool sizing when `--max-total-tokens` is unset.

On 8x B300 with TP8, MXFP8 KV cache, and `--mem-fraction-static 0.75`, automatic sizing selects:

```text
full_layer_tokens=21638400, swa_layer_tokens=2163840
target pool complete: 65.45 GB available
after seven draft pools: 0.35 GB available
eighth draft pool: CUDA OOM while allocating 5.16 GiB
```

The same failure occurs with BF16 KV cache, so this is not specific to MXFP8.

Omitting `--mem-fraction-static` is not a workaround. On this B300/TP8 configuration, the current heuristic resolves it to approximately `0.854` after the multimodal adjustment, which is higher than the explicitly tested `0.75`. Therefore `0.75` is already conservative relative to the default; the missing draft-pool accounting is the underlying problem.

#### Sizing behavior

Let `B` be the KV-cache memory budget remaining after model weights and other static allocations.

The current behavior is equivalent to:

```text
max_total_tokens = B / target KV bytes per token
```

However, multi-layer EAGLE also allocates eight draft KV pools using the same token capacity. The calculation should account for their aggregate per-token cost:

```text
max_total_tokens =
    B / (target KV bytes per token + sum of all draft KV bytes per token)
```

Otherwise the target pool fits by itself, but target plus all draft pools exceed `B` and startup fails during draft-pool initialization. Lowering `mem_fraction_static` only leaves extra unbudgeted headroom and may mask the missing term; it does not fix the calculation.

Explicit `--max-total-tokens 1048576` is a workaround: on the previous image digest it started successfully and returned correct responses with both BF16 and MXFP8 KV cache. Without the flag, both variants failed during draft-pool allocation.

Related: #29857 concerns under-allocation on another hybrid model; this issue is over-allocation because built-in multi-layer draft pools are omitted from profiling.

### Reproduction

Run on one 8x B300 node without `--max-total-tokens`:

```bash
docker run --rm --gpus all --ipc=host \
  -v /path/to/Inkling-NVFP4:/models/Inkling-NVFP4:ro \
  lmsysorg/sglang:inkling-cu13@sha256:0641550da4d069753be7f16e3a5f418e4f195fb9235637d2cdc9f5accda5786b \
  python3 -m sglang.launch_server \
    --model-path /models/Inkling-NVFP4 \
    --trust-remote-code \
    --tp-size 8 \
    --quantization modelopt_fp4 \
    --attention-backend fa4 \
    --page-size 128 \
    --fp4-gemm-backend flashinfer_trtllm \
    --moe-runner-backend flashinfer_trtllm_routed \
    --enable-torch-symm-mem \
    --mamba-radix-cache-strategy extra_buffer \
    --mem-fraction-static 0.75 \
    --swa-full-tokens-ratio 0.1 \
    --mamba-full-memory-ratio 0.1 \
    --kv-cache-dtype mxfp8 \
    --enable-multimodal \
    --speculative-algorithm EAGLE \
    --speculative-num-steps 8 \
    --speculative-eagle-topk 1 \
    --speculative-num-draft-tokens 9 \
    --enable-multi-layer-eagle \
    --speculative-use-rejection-sampling
```

Startup fails in `multi_layer_eagle_worker_v2.py::alloc_memory_pool` while allocating the eighth draft pool.

### Environment

Relevant `python3 -m sglang.check_env` output from the reproducing image:

```text
Python: 3.12.3
GPU: 8x NVIDIA B300 SXM6 AC (compute capability 10.3)
CUDA: 13.0 (driver 580.126.20)
PyTorch: 2.11.0+cu130
sglang: 0.0.0.dev0
sglang-kernel: 0.4.4
flashinfer: 0.6.14
transformers: 5.12.1
triton: 3.6.0
```

Image:

```text
tag manifest: sha256:5099f18aec336b30eb733524d2a277d1b348e4bf77a1c8950f90c96e6741f22e
amd64 digest: sha256:0641550da4d069753be7f16e3a5f418e4f195fb9235637d2cdc9f5accda5786b
```
title: [Bug] Inkling multi-layer EAGLE auto KV sizing OOMs while allocating draft pools
